laws.rule: Foreign tourists pay an area levy once on entering Nusa Penida, and separately for Nusa Lembongan and Nusa Ceningan: adult IDR 25,000 (about A$1.96, RBA rate of 30 October 2026), child aged 4 to 13 IDR 15,000 (about A$1.17). Collection is cashless.
laws.heading: Perda Klungkung 4/2026, attachment

laws.rule: A separate fee applies at each tourist attraction (DTW) visited, payable by all tourists, foreign and domestic.
laws.heading: Pengumuman penting

laws.rule: Prewedding or commercial photo shoots: IDR 500,000 a package for foreigners (about A$39.12), IDR 300,000 for domestic. Commercial film or video clip shoots IDR 2,000,000 a package (about A$156).
laws.heading: Perda Klungkung 4/2026, special services

local-law.note: Nusa Penida, Lembongan and Ceningan. Start date conflict: the tourism office notice says collection starts 12 August 2026, the regency protocol page (citing an adjustment letter of 10 August) says 1 September 2026. In addition to Bali's provincial IDR 150,000 levy.
